nodes.statement: Let B be a ring and let h,x,y,s B satisfy x^2+y^3=hs, (h,y)=B. Then the B -algebra \[ C=B[U,V,W]/(U^3+hV-x,\,-U^2+hW-y,\, S(h,U,V,W)-s) \] is isomorphic to B[T] , where T is an indeterminate.
